_comment: Where the catalog keeps things: read by tools/catalog_paths.py and .mjs, so every tool
takes its paths from here.  Paths are relative to the catalog root (the folder above
tools/, served by the render server at urlRoot) and '/'-separated: one string is a file
path, a server URL and a render job's outDir (the driver saves under the root).
family: the kind of groups the tools build (wp = the 17 wallpaper groups; later frieze,
spherical, hyperbolic).  familyDir: the family's page tree ('' = the root itself).
dataDir: its manifests.  jobsDir: its render jobs.  presetsDir: its symdraw presets, in
